column1: # Static human tRNA gene-copy reference for tai_human_trna_gene_copy.
# Counts were derived from the isotype and anticodon in every FASTA header.
# Anticodons are written 5-prime to 3-prime in DNA alphabet (T instead of U).
# The one selenocysteine entry is excluded. Initiator and elongator Met-CAT
# copies are combined because both decode ATG in this static supply proxy.
